Data availability">  Data availability  
              
               The satellite-constrained four-decade global river annual POC flux dataset is available via Zenodo at  https://zenodo.org/records/20337044  (ref.   83  ). The Global River Widths from Landsat (GRWL) database (version 01.01) is available at  https://zenodo.org/records/1297434 . The Global River Discharge Reanalysis dataset (GRDR) is available at  https://www.reachhydro.org/home/records/grfr . Landsat images are available from the US Geological Survey ( https://earthexplorer.usgs.gov/ ) and Google Earth Engine ( https://earthengine.google.com/ ). Fire information is available under the umbrella of the Global Wildfire Information System (GWIS;  https://gwis.jrc.ec.europa.eu/ ). Yedoma permafrost data are sourced from IRYP v2 ( https://apgc.awi.de/dataset/iryp-v2 ). The georeferenced dam data are available from the Global Dam Watch database ( https://www.globaldamwatch.org/ ). ERA5 reanalysis data are available at  https://cds.climate.copernicus.eu/ .  Source data  are provided with this paper.
